Card: #34604 · claim 6940534843 · os-dev-report 6942457211 (head 9b6b5b02) · final-head note 6942491477

All three card items are built in both arms, inside the claim's surface. The claim's Clause-② condition (no new key, no exported prop or type) holds, and the hand-resolved merge with #34642 keeps both features. No must-fix. One should-fix is paper only (the PR body).

### Must-fix

None.

### Should-fix

1. **The PR body's readings are stale.** "Readings at head ea132c47" (10 tests, 235 files / 2628 tests) and the "Overlaps #34642 … conflicts … exit 1" line come from before merge `f85988ac`. The current readings (11/11, 236 files / 2636 tests, overlap clean) are in os-dev-report 6942457211 and the PR comment 6942491477. The seat refreshes the body when it applies PR-body edits. This does not block landing; the comment already corrects the record on the PR.

### Readings that hold

| Item | Reading |
|:--|:--|
| PR shape | Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #34604`, with no other closing verb. No `!` and no `(narrowing)`, so no dogfood battery is owed. |
| Scope | 4 files: `ModalForm.tsx` (+52/−6), the new `modalMaximize.ts`, the new `modalMaximize-34604.test.tsx` and the changeset. All are inside claim 6940534843. `mobile-dialog-content.tsx` is not touched (the claim allowed it only if needed). |
| (a) Clause-② condition | Labels come from `t('detail.maximize')` / `t('detail.restoreSize')`, which exist in all 11 packs (zh-Hans `最大化` / `还原`). Only the no-provider English defaults table in `ModalForm` gains the two entries, and they match en byte for byte. `modalMaximize.ts` is imported only by `ModalForm`: `index.tsx` and `core.ts` have 0 references to it. `ModalFormProps` is unchanged, and `RecordTopBarButton` is an existing `@object-ui/components` export. No spec key. |
| (b) Both arms, form stays mounted | `{maximizeButton}` is the last child of both `MobileDialogContent`s (subforms arm and flat arm). Toggling changes only `sizeClass` / `heightClass` / `data-maximized` on the same content node, with no `key`. Pinned by element identity: the same dialog node and the same input element across two toggles, in both arms. Ablation 2 (adding `key={maximized…}`) turns the two flat identity tests red. Typed values and an added master-detail line survive. |
| (c) Columns | `effectiveModalSize` returns `'full'` first when maximized, and `undeclaredColumns = dialogUndeclaredColumns(layoutFieldCount, effectiveModalSize)` reads it. Pinned: 16 undeclared fields read 3 per row at `@4xl` in the inferred `xl`, 4 maximized, 3 restored. Ablation 1 (no override) turns 10/10 red. |
| (d) #34599 discard guard | Pinned maximized in both arms: the X still opens "Discard changes?", and the master-detail sticky Save bar (`md-form-submit`) is still drawn. The guard and `attemptClose` are not edited. |
| (e) Merge with #34642 | `git show --remerge-diff f85988ac`: the one conflict is the flat arm's `DialogHeader` class. It resolves to `cn(headerClass, !drawsSectionNav && 'border-b')`, keeping #34642's strip-owned rule, with `headerClass` carrying `sm:pr-20` and no `border-b`. The subforms arm gets `cn(headerClass, 'border-b')`, so its rule is unchanged. Otherwise the hook call moves above the comment block, with no logic change. Commit `9b6b5b02` pins the nav strip as the same node across two toggles. |
| Phone and height | The switch is `hidden sm:inline-flex`. `heightClass` keeps `h-[100dvh]` on a phone in both states. From `sm` up, `sm:h-auto sm:max-h-[90vh]` becomes `sm:h-[95dvh] sm:max-h-[95dvh]` when maximized, and the author's `className` / `schema.className` still come last. |
| Preference | `modal-form-maximized:OBJECT` in `localStorage`, with every access in try/catch and a `typeof window` guard. Restore removes the entry. The render-phase re-seed when `objectName` changes is the React "adjust state on prop change" pattern. Pinned: the same object reopens maximized, another object does not, restore forgets, a handed-over object takes its own choice, and a throwing `Storage` keeps the switch working. ui AGENTS.md #8 (per-object preference in local storage) is followed. |
| Changeset | `patch` on `@object-ui/plugin-form`, the only published package whose `src` moved. Each bullet matches the code, including "On a phone … shown from the `sm` breakpoint up only" and "An authored `modalSize` is still the size the dialog opens with". |
| Tests | 11 new tests, plus the 236-file / 2636-test package suite on this head, with no existing pin edited (`dialogDefaultLayout-12521`, `modalViewportGutter-12593`, `modalCloseButton-11061`, `ObjectForm.mobileFullscreen` all unchanged). Type-check exits 0. 38/38 derived gates. The two ablations are restored with `git diff HEAD` empty. |
| UI strings | No new key; both labels are translated in all 11 packs. |
| Docs | The `modalSize` description ("Size bucket of the dialog a caller opens this form in", `references/ui/view.mdx`) and `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-form.mdx:90` stay true: the authored size is still the opening size. No page describes the dialog's header chrome, so nothing is made false. |
| Acceptance | 1: maximize keeps the typed values, and restore gives back the previous size class. 2: the subforms arm keeps its lines across toggles. Both are pinned. Not read in a live browser (none claimed). |
| Tier | `check-governed-merges --pr 34703`: NOT governed, 549 lines. Tier S, lands through o3-B. |
| CI on this head | 52 check-runs: 39 `success`, 13 `skipped`, none failed or pending. Test UI 10 planned shards plus the aggregate, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Check Changeset, Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are all `success`. |

### Notes

1. **Escape while maximized** runs the close guard, whereas the record drawer's Escape restores first. Declared in the PR, and not asked by the card. If the two surfaces should match exactly, that is a p3 follow-up.
2. **An authored `modalSize: 'full'`** still draws the switch, and there it only lifts the height cap. Declared. It reads as intended.
